title: Reviewer home kept for diagnosis
summary: Reviewer runs now keep their per-run home directory when OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME is set, so the child's stdout/stderr and session files survive for diagnosis. The review workflow mounts out/reviewer-home as TMPDIR for all three reviewer jobs and uploads it as an artifact, and codex drops --ephemeral so its session is no longer discarded. Seeded login paths are stripped from the kept home before it is written, and a failed run prints only the last stderr line to the console — never into the journalled reason.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: three reviewer jobs + collector
nodes.summary: Declares the codex, claude and opencode reviewer jobs. Each now creates out/reviewer-home, passes OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1 and TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home into the container, and uploads the folder as an artifact.

nodes.label: out/reviewer-home
nodes.subtitle: mounted TMPDIR
nodes.summary: A host directory created before the container runs and mounted at /out. It becomes the reviewer's TMPDIR, so the kept home lands on the host and can be uploaded.

nodes.label: review-home-* artifact
nodes.subtitle: upload-artifact, if: always()
nodes.summary: Uploads out/reviewer-home after each reviewer job, even on failure, so the kept home can be inspected after the run.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: entry point
nodes.summary: The command the workflow invokes inside the container; it drives home preparation, child execution and journalling.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: per-run home + Drop
nodes.summary: Owns the reviewer's temporary home. Its Drop now checks keep_home() and, when set, leaves the directory in place and prints where it is instead of removing it.

nodes.label: keep_home()
nodes.subtitle: OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME
nodes.summary: Reads OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME from the environment. Presence alone turns on home retention; the value is not inspected.

nodes.label: preserve_home()
nodes.subtitle: strip logins, write child output
nodes.summary: When the home is kept, removes every seeded login path from it and writes child.stdout and child.stderr into the home. It never reads a verdict or finding from the home.

nodes.label: last_non_empty_line()
nodes.subtitle: trim, cap at 200 chars
nodes.summary: Extracts the last non-blank line of stderr, trimmed and capped at 200 characters, for the console diagnostic on a failed run.

nodes.label: run_child()
nodes.subtitle: spawn, drain, cleanup
nodes.summary: Now keeps the home handle, joins stderr instead of discarding it, calls preserve_home after cleanup, and on a non-zero exit prints the last stderr line to the console while the returned reason stays free of reviewer text.

nodes.label: prepare_command()
nodes.subtitle: builds child command + home
nodes.summary: Builds the child command, the RunHome and the login notes. Unchanged, but it is what seeds the login paths that preserve_home later strips.

nodes.label: AGENTS registry
nodes.subtitle: codex clean_copy switches
nodes.summary: The codex entry drops --ephemeral from its clean-copy switches, so codex no longer discards its session; the comment now says the first two switches ignore user config and rules files.

nodes.label: codex exec
nodes.subtitle: session now persists
nodes.summary: Runs without --ephemeral, so its session files are written into the home rather than thrown away.

nodes.label: claude reviewer
nodes.subtitle: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
nodes.summary: Runs with the same home-retention environment; its session files now survive in the kept home.

nodes.label: opencode reviewer
nodes.subtitle: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Runs with the same home-retention environment; its session files now survive in the kept home.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: verdicts and reasons
nodes.summary: The record the collector reads. The kept home is explicitly not this: no verdict, finding or reason is ever read from it, and stderr still never enters a journalled reason.

edges.label: OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1, TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home
edges.summary: Each reviewer job now passes the retention flag and points TMPDIR at the mounted out/reviewer-home, which is what makes the kept home land on the host.

edges.label: mkdir -p out/reviewer-home
edges.summary: The job creates the directory before the container starts so the mount point exists.

edges.label: upload-artifact, if: always()
edges.summary: The kept home is uploaded after the job, even when the reviewer failed, which is the point of keeping it.

edges.label: holds the home handle
edges.summary: run_child now binds the home returned by prepare_command instead of discarding it, so it can preserve it after the child exits.

edges.label: Drop consults the flag
edges.summary: RunHome::drop asks keep_home() before removing the directory; when set it leaves the home and prints its path.

edges.label: after cleanup()
edges.summary: After the child exits and cleanup runs, run_child writes the child's output into the home and strips seeded logins.

edges.label: removes reviewer.login_paths
edges.summary: preserve_home deletes every path prepare_command seeded as a login, so the kept home carries no credential.

edges.label: on non-zero exit
edges.summary: A failed run takes the last non-empty stderr line and prints it to the console, where only a person diagnosing the run reads it.

edges.label: reason only, no stderr
edges.summary: The returned reason stays reviewer-text-free, so nothing reviewer-controlled reaches the journal.

edges.label: --ephemeral removed
edges.summary: Dropping --ephemeral means codex writes its session into the home instead of discarding it, which is what makes the kept home worth uploading.

edges.label: session files
edges.summary: Codex's session files now persist in the reviewer home rather than being ephemeral.

edges.label: session files
edges.summary: Claude's session files land in the same home and are now kept.

edges.label: session files
edges.summary: Opencode's session files land in the same home and are now kept.
